evidence.scope: Isolated in-memory backend testing (dbPath ':memory:'). Covers backend signaling, StoreKit JWS verification contracts, and account deletion contracts. Does NOT cover native iOS UI rendering, real WebRTC decoded media, or live production deployment.

implementation: Added official Apple App Store Server Library (@apple/app-store-server-library v3.1.0) with SignedDataVerifier in lib/store.js.
Separate verification routing: platform === 'ios' or token containing '.' routes to verifyApple(); Google Play verification routes to verifyGoogle() with 100% backwards compatibility.
Product allowlist enforcement against STORE_PRODUCTS (kinnect_style_aurora, ocean, sunset, studio_pro); mismatched products fail 422.
Bundle ID enforcement against appleVerifier.bundleId ('app.kinnect.live'); foreign bundle IDs fail 422.
Account binding verification: transactions with appAccountToken must match storeAccountId(userId) or userId, else 403.

Transaction uniqueness & idempotency: token_hash = hash('apple:' + transactionId). Replay by another account rejected with 409; replay by same user returns 200 existing state idempotently without duplicate rows.
Revocation & refund lifecycle: transactions with revocationDate are updated to CANCELLED and rejected with 422.
Never credits from client transactionId alone: raw string without signed JWS fails 400 immediately.

StoreKit restoration UI in WalletStoreView.swift explicitly clarifies that StoreKit restore applies to non-consumable packages/styles, while consumable coins are restored via account ledger upon login.

externalBlockers.APPLE_BUNDLE_ID: Must be set to production App Store bundle ID (app.kinnect.live)
externalBlockers.APPLE_ENVIRONMENT: Set to Production or Sandbox depending on deployment stage
externalBlockers.APPLE_ROOT_CERT_FILE: Path to DER-encoded Apple Root CA certificate (AppleRootCA-G3.cer) for live X.509 chain trust verification
externalBlockers.APPLE_KEY_ID_AND_PRIVATE_KEY: App Store Connect API key credentials required for server-to-server notifications and server API lookup
externalBlockers.APP_STORE_CONNECT_PRODUCTS: Configured in-app purchase product IDs on App Store Connect must match STORE_PRODUCTS IDs
